282949682.description:
A.T. Cross
12 Kt Gold Filled Pen and Pencil Set
Classic Century, Vintage 20th Century
This vintage Cross writing instrument set features a matching ballpoint pen and mechanical pencil finished in 12 karat gold filled casing with classic linear reeding. Crafted with the slender, elegant silhouette that defines the iconic Classic Century design, each piece is accented with conical black top accents and signature pocket clips. The set is housed in its original black textured presentation box with a red velvet-lined interior tray.
Genuine 12 Kt. gold filled construction with vertically fluted barrels
Set includes one twist-action ballpoint pen and one matching pencil
Marked "CROSS" and "12 KT. GOLD FILLED" on display tray
Outer box marked "CROSS SET - No. 6601 12 KT. GOLD FILLED"
Presentation box measures 7 x 3 x 1 inches
Condition:
Very good vintage condition with gentle surface handling wear and micro-scratches consistent with age. Original box displays light exterior scuffs and corner shelf wear. Twist mechanisms appear intact. Only includes what is shown in pictures, any accessories or items not shown but described cannot be guaranteed to be included with the lot.
THANK YOU FOR YOUR PURCHASE!
If you’re happy and you know it, please leave a 5-star rating! If there is a problem with your order, please contact us via Shop Goodwill before opening returns/claims. We strive to return all messages within one business day.
Please click the shipping estimate link in the listing to get the shipping costs directly from FedEx.  There will be no discounts or price changes after an auction has ended.
Our shipping team works hard to get out all orders as quickly as possible, that being said it may take up to 5 business days after payment for your order to ship out.  Once it ships out you will receive tracking information.
***IMPORTANT*** If your item was damaged in transit, do not throw away anything, including the box or packing materials until we have authorized you to do so. Photos will be required to file insurance claims.
Our Business hours: Monday - Friday  8:00 am to 4:00 pm Central
New items and unique treasures are added daily, come back soon!
